macros.name: figureversion
macros.doc: The \figureversion command can be used to change the figure version by a single command.

macros.name: fontfigurealignment
macros.doc: Using this command, you can choose either ‘proportional’ or ‘tabular’ figures.

macros.name: liningfigures
macros.doc: If you only want to change the figure style for a short amount of text, you can use the corresponding text font commands \liningfigures and \textfigures, which take as argument the text to which the figure style should apply.

macros.name: mathfigurealignment
macros.doc: To change the math figure alignment, use this command.

macros.name: mathweight
macros.doc: The package knows two different math weights ‘normal’ and ‘bold’, which can be accessed by this command.

macros.name: textfigures
macros.doc: If you only want to change the figure style for a short amount of text, you can use the corresponding text font commands \liningfigures and \textfigures, which take as argument the text to which the figure style should apply.
